panels.description: Running when total permeate flow (FIT-20211 + FIT-20231) averages above 5 m³/h over the last 15 minutes.

targets.query: SELECT mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt")+mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt") FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Plant

panels.description: Permeate from both trains (FIT-20211 + FIT-20231). today = volume since midnight IST. ↗ = on pace for the full day (average flow since midnight × 24 h). ⌀ = average per day over the last 30 complete days.

targets.query: SELECT integral("MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt",1h)+integral("MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt",1h) AS "today" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}'
SELECT mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt")*24+mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt")*24 AS "pace" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}'
SELECT (integral("MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt",1h)+integral("MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt",1h))/30 AS "avg_m3" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}' - 30d AND time < '${todayStart}'

panels.title: Treated water

panels.description: Plant power (main energy meter) divided by permeate flow. Today = since midnight IST. ⌀ = last 30 complete days.

targets.query: SELECT abs(mean("MFM_Data-TotalActivePower"))/1000/(mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt")+mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt")) AS "today" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}'

SELECT abs(mean("MFM_Data-TotalActivePower"))/1000/(mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt")+mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt")) AS "⌀" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}' - 30d AND time < '${todayStart}'

panels.title: Energy intensity

targets.query: SELECT abs(mean("MFM_Data-TotalActivePower"))/1000 FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.description: Permeate flow (FIT-20211), MBR tank level and scouring air: last 15 min. TMP, permeability (temperature-corrected, ×1000 → LMH/mbar) and flux: averaged over permeation only (flow above 5 m³/h). Limits not yet defined, so values are shown neutral.

targets.query: SELECT mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt") AS "Permeate", last("MBR-Instruments-LIT20210") AS "Tank level", mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20263") AS "Scour air" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT mean("MBR-CalcParameters-TMP20200mqtt") AS "TMP", mean("MBR-CalcParameters-PermeabilityTrain1TC") AS "Permeability", mean("MBR-CalcParameters-FluxTrain1") AS "Flux" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter AND "MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt" > 5

panels.title: Train 1

panels.description: Permeate flow (FIT-20231), MBR tank level and scouring air: last 15 min. TMP, permeability (temperature-corrected, ×1000 → LMH/mbar) and flux: averaged over permeation only (flow above 5 m³/h). Limits not yet defined, so values are shown neutral.

targets.query: SELECT mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt") AS "Permeate", last("MBR-Instruments-LIT20230") AS "Tank level", mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20262") AS "Scour air" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT mean("MBR-CalcParameters-TMP20220mqtt") AS "TMP", mean("MBR-CalcParameters-PermeabilityTrain2TC") AS "Permeability", mean("MBR-CalcParameters-FluxTrain2") AS "Flux" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter AND "MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt" > 5

panels.title: Train 2

panels.description: Blower power from the VFDs, last 5 min. Green = running; ○ off = below 1 kW (off or standby). MBR scour blowers: B-20204 → Train 1 (202-T-04), B-20203 → Train 2 (202-T-08), B-20205 → Train 3 (202-T-12, not in service). B-20206 → aeration tanks 202-T-02/06/10. B-20101 → converted aeration tank 201-T-01. B-20201 = common standby. Source: Nanded IO list rev 1 and P&ID 20000-1-1001.

targets.query: SELECT last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_kW") AS "Train 1 scour · B-20204", last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_kW") AS "Train 2 scour · B-20203", last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_kW") AS "Train 3 scour · B-20205", last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_kW") AS "Aeration tanks · B-20206", last("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_kW") AS "Pre-aeration · B-20101", last("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_kW") AS "Common standby · B-20201" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Blowers

panels.description: Online COD analyser, treated water tank (AIT-30103A), 15-min average. ⌀ = last 30 complete days.

targets.query: SELECT mean("Treated_Water_Tank-Instruments-AIT30103A") AS "now" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time > now() - 15m
SELECT mean("Treated_Water_Tank-Instruments-AIT30103A") AS "⌀" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}' - 30d AND time < '${todayStart}'

panels.title: Treated COD

panels.description: Online TSS analyser, treated water tank (AIT-30103B), 15-min average. ⌀ = last 30 complete days.

targets.query: SELECT mean("Treated_Water_Tank-Instruments-AIT30103B") AS "now" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time > now() - 15m
SELECT mean("Treated_Water_Tank-Instruments-AIT30103B") AS "⌀" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}' - 30d AND time < '${todayStart}'

panels.title: Treated TSS

panels.description: Aeration tank dissolved oxygen, Train 1 (AIT-20202), 15-min average. ⌀ = last 30 complete days.

targets.query: SELECT mean("Anoxic_Aeration-Instruments-AIT20202") AS "now" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time > now() - 15m
SELECT mean("Anoxic_Aeration-Instruments-AIT20202") AS "⌀" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}' - 30d AND time < '${todayStart}'

panels.title: DO · Train 1

panels.description: Aeration tank dissolved oxygen, Train 2 (AIT-20222), 15-min average. A reading of zero indicates a sensor or signal fault. ⌀ = last 30 complete days.

targets.query: SELECT mean("Anoxic_Aeration-Instruments-AIT20222") AS "now" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time > now() - 15m
SELECT mean("Anoxic_Aeration-Instruments-AIT20222") AS "⌀" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE time >= '${todayStart}' - 30d AND time < '${todayStart}'

panels.title: DO · Train 2

panels.description: Days since the most recent maintenance clean of Train 1 (alkaline, acid, or alkaline + acid), from the operators’ MBR cleaning log.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_part('day', now() - max(cleaning_start_datetime)) AS "Days since last clean" FROM public.user_mbrcleaninglogandchemicalconsumptiondata WHERE mbr_train = '1' AND cleaning_type IN ('Alkaline MC','Acid MC','Alkaline + Acid MC')

panels.title: Last membrane clean · T1

panels.description: Days since the most recent maintenance clean of Train 2 (alkaline, acid, or alkaline + acid), from the operators’ MBR cleaning log.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_part('day', now() - max(cleaning_start_datetime)) AS "Days since last clean" FROM public.user_mbrcleaninglogandchemicalconsumptiondata WHERE mbr_train = '2' AND cleaning_type IN ('Alkaline MC','Acid MC','Alkaline + Acid MC')

panels.title: Last membrane clean · T2

panels.description: Energy intensity (plant power ÷ permeate flow) over the selected time range; bucket size adapts to the range (hourly for short ranges, about daily for a month). Dashed line = average over the period shown.

targets.query: SELECT abs(mean("MFM_Data-TotalActivePower"))/1000/(mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt")+mean("MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt")) AS "Daily" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Energy intensity · kWh/m³

panels.description: Transmembrane pressure during permeation only (train flow above 5 m³/h), over the selected time range. Rising TMP signals fouling.

targets.query: SELECT mean("MBR-CalcParameters-TMP20200mqtt") AS "Train 1" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter AND "MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt" > 5 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("MBR-CalcParameters-TMP20220mqtt") AS "Train 2" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter AND "MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt" > 5 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: TMP (permeation) · mbar

panels.description: Temperature-corrected permeability during permeation, over the selected time range. Recovery after each cleaning shows its effectiveness; a steady decline signals fouling.

targets.query: SELECT mean("MBR-CalcParameters-PermeabilityTrain1TC") AS "Train 1" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter AND "MBR-Instruments-FIT20211mqtt" > 5 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("MBR-CalcParameters-PermeabilityTrain2TC") AS "Train 2" FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter AND "MBR-Instruments-FIT20231mqtt" > 5 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Permeability · LMH/mbar
